newsitem.title: CANADA: Viridian holders approve Agrium deal.
newsitem.headline: Viridian holders approve Agrium deal.

text.p: Canadian fertilizer company Viridian Inc said on Tuesday that shareholders approved its C$1.3-billion merger with Calgary-based Agrium Inc.
Viridian said its shares were expected to be delisted from the Toronto Stock Exchange on December 13.
Completion of the merger was expected to occur later on Tuesday. Under the share-swap offer, Viridian shareholders were to receive 0.975 Agrium shares for each Viridian share.
The companies said the merger, which was announced in October, was to create an operation valued at C$2.5 billion.
